examples.arabic: أليس المهرجان في ساحة الجامعة الرئيسية، حيث نجتمع دائماً لتبادل الأحاديث الثقافية المشتركة؟
examples.english: Isn't the festival in the main university square, where we always gather to exchange shared cultural conversations?
examples.transliteration: Alaysa al-mahrajan fee sahat al-jami'ah ar-ra'eesiyyah, haythu najtami'u da'iman li-tabadul al-ahadeeth ath-thaqafiyyah al-mushtarakah?
examples.storyTitle: An Appointment on Al Mutanabbi Street

examples.arabic: شقت الحافلة طريقها بصعوبة نحو وسط البلد حيث تتقاطع شوارع القاهرة القديمة مع المباني ذات الطراز المعماري الأوروبي.
examples.english: The bus navigated its way with difficulty toward Downtown, where the streets of old Cairo intersect with buildings of European architectural style.
examples.transliteration: shaqqati al-hafilatu tariqaha bi-su'ubatin nahwa wasati al-baladi haythu tataqata'u shawari'u al-qahirati al-qadimati ma'a al-mabani dhati at-tirazi al-mi'mariyyi al-urubbiyyi.
examples.storyTitle: A Race Against Time in Downtown

examples.arabic: ارشدني شاب ودود الى عبور مفترق الطرق عند اشارة المرور ومن ثم الانعطاف يمينا عند الدوار الكبير حيث يقع مبنى المكتبة
examples.english: A friendly young man guided me to cross the intersection at the traffic light and then turn right at the large roundabout where the library building is located.
examples.transliteration: Arshadani shabbun wadudun ila 'uburi muftaraqi al-turuqi 'inda isharati al-mururi wa min thamma al-in'itafi yaminan 'inda al-duwwari al-kabiri haythu yaqa'u mabna al-maktabati.

examples.arabic: توجهت سارة الى مكتبها حيث بدأت عملها بهمة ونشاط
examples.english: Sarah headed to her office where she began her work with enthusiasm and energy.
examples.transliteration: Tawajjahat Sara ila maktabiha haythu bada'at 'amalaha bi-himmatin wa nashatin.

examples.arabic: بعد الصلاة تناول فطوره السريع مع اسرته حيث تبادلوا اطراف الحديث
examples.english: After the prayer, he had his quick breakfast with his family where they exchanged conversations.
examples.transliteration: Ba'da al-salat, tanawala futoorahu al-saree'a ma'a usratihi haythu tabadaloo atraf al-hadeeth.

examples.arabic: توجهت ليلى بعد ذلك نحو قسم المخطوطات، حيث كان موظف الاستقبال يستعد لإغلاق نافذته للراحة.
examples.english: Layla then headed towards the manuscripts department, where the reception employee was preparing to close his window for a break.
examples.transliteration: Tawajjahat Layla ba'da thalika nahwa qismi al-makhtootat, haythu kana muwaddafu al-istiqbali yasta'iddu li'ighlaqi nafithatihi lilrahat.
examples.storyTitle: Urgent Greetings at the National Library
